name: Four Seasons Astir Palace Hotel Athens
insider_take: This legendary palace sits on the exclusive Astir Peninsula, where Athenian elite have escaped for decades - now reimagined as Four Seasons' crown jewel of the Greek Riviera.
whats_special: Built on a private 75-acre peninsula in Vouliagmeni, this resort occupies the former playground of Greek shipping magnates and Hollywood stars. The property features three pristine beaches, each facing different directions to capture perfect light throughout the day. The hotel's Spa draws from the nearby Lake Vouliagmeni's therapeutic mineral waters, famous since ancient times for their healing properties.
pro_tip: Book a sunset table at Pelagos restaurant - it's positioned on the western tip of the peninsula for unobstructed views of the Temple of Poseidon at Sounion across the water.
dont_miss: Take the complimentary boat transfer to explore hidden coves along the Athenian Riviera, and visit the mystical Lake Vouliagmeni just 5 minutes away - this geothermal lake maintains a constant 70°F year-round and is connected to underground caves that remain unexplored.
pros: Exclusive beachfront location on the Athenian Riviera
Exceptional Four Seasons service and luxury amenities
Multiple dining options with Mediterranean cuisine
cons: Located outside central Athens requiring transportation
